The reference plan is illustrative and usually infeasible; changes explain what had to move, they are NOT an efficiency improvement claim (that needs a comparison with a feasible plan).

freeze.rule: Among proposals from turns 1-2 that pass full validation, rank by (1) most agents whose latest stated conditions are all satisfied by the plan, (2) fewest agents who rejected it, (3) most agents who accepted it with conditions resolved, (4) lowest fixed-weight total cost, (5) earliest version. Pick the first.
